image_description: Two fabric baby bibs lying flat on a striped surface. The bib on the left features a patchwork design with pink gingham and floral patterns, while the bib on the right has a white background with a green floral print and pink gingham trim. Both appear to be made of soft cotton or similar textile.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify if the patchwork patterns on the left bib align logically at the seams. Check for any 'melting' of the floral pattern into the background on the right bib. Ensure the shadows cast by the bibs onto the striped surface are physically consistent with a flat lay.
